items.title: Performance of artificial intelligence versus clinician left-ventricular segmentation of cardiac MRI for mortality prediction: a retrospective, multicentre, prognostic study
items.excerpt: In 27,382 UK and US patients followed for more than five years (3,458 deaths), AI-derived ejection fraction from cardiac MRI predicted mortality slightly but significantly better than clinician measurements; the AI analysed each scan in about 2-3 seconds versus roughly 13 minutes for an expert (City St George's / UCL).
items.rationale: Head-to-head in 27k patients: AI cardiac-MRI ejection fraction predicts death at least as well as clinicians in seconds instead of ~13 minutes, a direct case for automating LV segmentation.

items.title: AI-Identified Reasons for Nonescalation of Lipid-Lowering Therapy for Secondary Prevention
items.excerpt: Large language models read clinical notes for 28,113 patients with ASCVD: among 13,810 with above-goal LDL-C, therapy was not escalated in 88.7% of relevant notes, and 40.4% of those documented a reason, most often patient-reported adverse effects (12.6%), LDL-C near goal (6.9%) and patient preference (6.8%).
items.rationale: LLMs mined 28k ASCVD charts to show why statin/lipid therapy goes unescalated, turning free-text notes into a measurable care-gap audit.

items.title: Commercial multimodal large language models show systematic model-specific errors in breast cancer pathology reporting: a paired concordance study
items.excerpt: Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro and GPT-5.5 were each given 16 H&E tiles per case for 427 invasive breast cancers and compared against a board-certified breast pathologist on Nottingham grade and receptor-defined subtype; each model showed systematic, model-specific errors.
items.rationale: Patient-safety check on general chatbots in pathology: three frontier MLLMs each mis-grade and mis-subtype breast cancers in their own systematic way across 427 cases.

items.title: FDA clears Deep Reasoning AI's neurovascular CTA software
items.excerpt: Deep Reasoning AI received FDA 510(k) clearance for NeuroDR, which runs automatically after a head-and-neck CTA, removes bone, soft tissue and veins, and sends 3D vessel reconstructions to PACS.
items.rationale: Regulatory clearance: a 510(k)-cleared tool auto-builds bone-free 3D neurovascular reconstructions from head-and-neck CTA straight into PACS.

items.title: AI-powered urine test distinguishes bladder disorders with up to 92% accuracy
items.excerpt: Asan Medical Center researchers developed an AI urine-testing technique that distinguishes interstitial cystitis, overactive bladder and healthy individuals with up to 92% accuracy, helping separate conditions with overlapping symptoms.
items.rationale: Non-invasive diagnosis: Asan Medical Center's AI urine test separates interstitial cystitis from overactive bladder, two conditions patients often wait years to tell apart.
